title: Price hosted residual crossings of a two-family shear
body:
A hosted single-family residual cannot in general be moved through a two-family shear for free. The exact source condition is `A(R-I)=0`; the target condition is `(R-I)A=0`. The package proves the unique compensating shears, identifies the current-source chart correction, and gives an exact rank-one scalar adapter floor. Singular and invertible bridges provide positive and negative fixtures.

Python 3.12.14 optimized registered replay passes for 86,112 matrix pairs, 517,632 basis or all-dirty input checks, 1,536 independent literal XOR states and three controls. Source pins and git diff checks pass.

This audits one explicit extension of the no-touch hosting premise; no actual selected bridge or new host assignment is claimed. Scalar defect rank is not equated with recursive address-frame rank. No supplier/native replay/kappa change. Credits and substantial OpenAI Codex assistance disclosed; Apache-2.0.

Base: `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`. [Coordinated research batch](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1163#discussioncomment-18922638); round 10. The selected record is unchanged.
